alerts.title: EFV Side Effects
alerts.message: Guidelines state EFV can cause persistent central nervous system toxicity, including insomnia and abnormal dreams. Patient complains of poor sleep and vivid dreams. EFV is a known cause, but other factors like stress or underlying conditions should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor patient's sleep and dreams, consider alternative regimen if symptoms persist.
